title: What movies do you consider the perfect example of their genre?

commenti.body:
Slasher - Black Christmas: Perfected the genre before Halloween, and is still unsettling. Bonus, has solid feminist undertones. 

Dark Comedy / Satire - Dr Strangelove: Like many of Kubrick’s, feels modern compared to other films of that era, and is nearly perfect. 

Fantasy - Fellowship of the Ring: Impossibly good adaptation. 

Action - Terminator 2: Absolutely rips from the first scene to the last. James Cameron in godmode. No mandatory tea breaks this time folks.

To me Pulp fiction is much more my go to example when talking about Post-modernism. 

I think we could easily say the The Good, The Bad and The Ugly is the quintessential Spaghetti Western and The Searcher would probably be the same for Classic American Western

Unforgiven is a good contender for what the French would call a Western Crépusculaire (or Dusk Western) and the Americans calls a Revisionist Western

Foxy Brown is the perfect example of the blaxploitation film. I think it’s the most interesting and captivating film from blaxploitation. But you’ve got to recreate the experience of an old drive-in movie theater at home to truly get the whole vibe. Back then you snuck in a couple blunts and malt liquor. They served hot dogs, hamburgers, French fries, nachos, and popcorn underneath the projection booth. Foxy Brown enjoyed right is the perfect introduction to the genre.

The Thing is a perfect monster movie.

Gallipoli is a perfect war film. 

Paddington 2 is a perfect stuffed bear film.

My Man Godfrey is a perfect screwball comedy. 

The Road Warrior is a perfect post-apocalypse action film.

Scarface (1932) is a perfect gangster film.

Drugstore Cowboy is a perfect drug film. 

Gold Diggers of 1933 is a perfect musical.

My Darling Clementine is a perfect western.

In the Mood for Love is a perfect romantic drama.

Army of Shadows is a perfect WWII film.

Hedwig and the Angry Inch is a perfect rock musical.

Flash Gordon is a perfect sci-fi film.

Stand By Me is a perfect (boys) coming of age film.

Double Indemnity is a perfect noir.
